list.name: environment
list.label: Environment
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT environment AS __text,environment AS __value FROM eez.dashboard_chain_context ORDER BY 1
list.definition: SELECT DISTINCT environment AS __text,environment AS __value FROM eez.dashboard_chain_context ORDER BY 1

list.name: deployment
list.label: Deployment
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT deployment AS __text,deployment AS __value FROM eez.dashboard_chain_context WHERE environment=${environment:sqlstring} ORDER BY 1
list.definition: SELECT DISTINCT deployment AS __text,deployment AS __value FROM eez.dashboard_chain_context WHERE environment=${environment:sqlstring} ORDER BY 1

list.name: chain
list.label: Source chain
list.query: SELECT role||' · '||chain_id::text AS __text,chain_instance_id::text AS __value FROM eez.dashboard_chain_context c WHERE c.environment=${environment:sqlstring} AND c.deployment=${deployment:sqlstring} ORDER BY role
list.definition: SELECT role||' · '||chain_id::text AS __text,chain_instance_id::text AS __value FROM eez.dashboard_chain_context c WHERE c.environment=${environment:sqlstring} AND c.deployment=${deployment:sqlstring} ORDER BY role

list.name: rollup
list.label: L2 rollup
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT rollup_id::text AS __text,rollup_id::text AS __value FROM eez.dashboard_chain_context c WHERE c.environment=${environment:sqlstring} AND c.deployment=${deployment:sqlstring} AND role='l2' ORDER BY 1
list.definition: SELECT DISTINCT rollup_id::text AS __text,rollup_id::text AS __value FROM eez.dashboard_chain_context c WHERE c.environment=${environment:sqlstring} AND c.deployment=${deployment:sqlstring} AND role='l2' ORDER BY 1

list.name: instance
list.label: Native instance
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT s.instance AS __text,s.instance AS __value FROM eez.lifecycle_coverage s WHERE s.deployment_id IN (SELECT deployment_id FROM eez.dashboard_chain_context c WHERE c.environment=${environment:sqlstring} AND c.deployment=${deployment:sqlstring}) ORDER BY 1
list.definition: SELECT DISTINCT s.instance AS __text,s.instance AS __value FROM eez.lifecycle_coverage s WHERE s.deployment_id IN (SELECT deployment_id FROM eez.dashboard_chain_context c WHERE c.environment=${environment:sqlstring} AND c.deployment=${deployment:sqlstring}) ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Exact charges and allocation boundaries
panels.description: Costs are exact receipt charges in each chain’s integer base units (wei). L1 external spend and L2 user fees remain separate. Reverted receipts are charged. Shared posting overhead uses equal_share_v1 estimates over verified native membership; these are not exact per-user charges. Missing or ambiguous populations remain unallocated. Settled-L2-transaction unit cost remains unavailable. Optional live funding panels show separately configured accounts and actual runtime candidate observations with explicit unknown evidence.

options.content: Costs are exact receipt charges in each chain’s integer base units (wei). L1 external spend and L2 user fees remain separate. Reverted receipts are charged. Shared posting overhead uses equal_share_v1 estimates over verified native membership; these are not exact per-user charges. Missing or ambiguous populations remain unallocated. Settled-L2-transaction unit cost, live balances and runway remain unavailable.

panels.title: Poster balance over time · L1 native units
panels.description: Observed balance of the configured L1 poster account. One native unit is one xDAI on Gnosis/Chiado (test xDAI on Chiado); no USD conversion. Shows retained Prometheus samples, including funding increases and spending decreases, from when collection began. Missing/invalid samples remain gaps. This configured-account panel uses environment/deployment scope, independently of the native-instance, source-chain and rollup selectors. It does not reconstruct older balances from spending or identify the runtime signer automatically.

panels.title: Configured-wallet spend over time · 5m
panels.description: Canonical receipt charges per five-minute bucket, including included reverts, separated by chain and configured wallet. A bucket with incomplete receipt accounting stays NULL. These populations overlap with other spend panels and must not be summed together. Plot uses native units (wei / 1e18); exact integer wei remains in the tables below.

targets.rawSql: SELECT date_bin(interval '5 minutes',to_timestamp(r.timestamp_seconds::double precision),to_timestamp(0)) AS "time",c.role||' chain '||c.chain_id::text||' · 0x'||encode(r.sender,'hex') AS metric,(CASE WHEN bool_and(r.accounting_gap IS NULL AND r.execution_paid IS NOT NULL AND r.blob_paid IS NOT NULL) THEN sum(r.execution_paid+r.blob_paid)/1e18 END)::double precision AS value FROM eez.wallet_receipts r JOIN eez.dashboard_chain_context c USING(chain_instance_id) WHERE c.environment=${environment:sqlstring} AND c.deployment=${deployment:sqlstring} AND (${chain:sqlstring}='all' OR c.chain_instance_id::text=${chain:sqlstring}) AND (${rollup:sqlstring}='all' OR c.role='l1' OR c.rollup_id::text=${rollup:sqlstring}) AND (to_timestamp(r.timestamp_seconds::double precision) BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()) AND r.source_valid GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2

panels.title: Paid posting spend over time · 5m
panels.description: Canonical receipt charges per five-minute bucket, including included reverts, separated by chain and success status. A bucket with incomplete receipt accounting stays NULL. These populations overlap with other spend panels and must not be summed together. Plot uses native units (wei / 1e18); exact integer wei remains in the tables below.

targets.rawSql: SELECT date_bin(interval '5 minutes',to_timestamp(r.timestamp_seconds::double precision),to_timestamp(0)) AS "time",c.role||' chain '||c.chain_id::text||CASE WHEN r.success THEN ' · successful' ELSE ' · reverted' END AS metric,(CASE WHEN bool_and(r.accounting_gap IS NULL AND r.execution_paid IS NOT NULL AND r.blob_paid IS NOT NULL) THEN sum(r.execution_paid+r.blob_paid)/1e18 END)::double precision AS value FROM eez.posting_receipts r JOIN eez.dashboard_chain_context c USING(chain_instance_id) WHERE c.environment=${environment:sqlstring} AND c.deployment=${deployment:sqlstring} AND (${chain:sqlstring}='all' OR c.chain_instance_id::text=${chain:sqlstring}) AND (${rollup:sqlstring}='all' OR c.role='l1' OR c.rollup_id::text=${rollup:sqlstring}) AND (to_timestamp(r.timestamp_seconds::double precision) BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()) AND r.source_valid GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2

panels.title: Selected receipt execution / blob spend · 5m
panels.description: Execution and blob components of the same selected canonical receipt population, separated by chain. Complete-accounting buckets only; no missing bucket is filled. Plot values are scaled native units, while the daily table retains exact wei. Do not add this population to wallet or posting charts.

targets.rawSql: SELECT date_bin(interval '5 minutes',to_timestamp(r.timestamp_seconds::double precision),to_timestamp(0)) AS "time",c.role||' chain '||c.chain_id::text AS metric,(CASE WHEN bool_and(r.accounting_gap IS NULL AND r.execution_paid IS NOT NULL AND r.blob_paid IS NOT NULL) THEN sum(r.execution_paid)/1e18 END)::double precision AS execution_native,(CASE WHEN bool_and(r.accounting_gap IS NULL AND r.execution_paid IS NOT NULL AND r.blob_paid IS NOT NULL) THEN sum(r.blob_paid)/1e18 END)::double precision AS blob_native FROM eez.canonical_receipts r JOIN eez.dashboard_chain_context c USING(chain_instance_id) WHERE c.environment=${environment:sqlstring} AND c.deployment=${deployment:sqlstring} AND (${chain:sqlstring}='all' OR c.chain_instance_id::text=${chain:sqlstring}) AND (${rollup:sqlstring}='all' OR c.role='l1' OR c.rollup_id::text=${rollup:sqlstring}) AND (to_timestamp(r.timestamp_seconds::double precision) BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()) AND r.source_valid GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2

panels.title: Configured account balances · current native units
panels.description: Current configured observer accounts for the selected environment/deployment, kept separate by account, chain role and observer instance. Balance refers to its verified canonical anchor. SQL chain/rollup/source-hash and Native instance filters do not select these configured accounts. Display values are approximate native units, not fiat.

panels.title: Configured account runway · positive covered burn
panels.description: Current observer account runway from a fully covered positive canonical spend window. Zero burn, missing history, stale balances and changed cursors remain Unknown. All configured roles in the selected environment/deployment are shown; accounts are not inferred from native signing identities.

panels.title: Actual runtime poster · candidate reserve covered
panels.description: Exact native comparison for a recently observed actual poster candidate. Requires fresh estimate and balance flags. An insufficient blob-only minimum also proves Not fundable; it does not estimate execution gas. These signing accounts are independent of observer-configured addresses. No current candidate is Unknown.

targets.expr: reth_eez_poster_can_fund_candidate{environment=~"${environment:regex}",deployment=~"${deployment:regex}",service="eez-composer",instance=~"${instance:regex}"} and on(environment,deployment,job,instance) (reth_eez_poster_funding_estimate_valid{environment=~"${environment:regex}",deployment=~"${deployment:regex}",service="eez-composer",instance=~"${instance:regex}"} == 1) and on(environment,deployment,job,instance) (reth_eez_poster_funding_balance_valid{environment=~"${environment:regex}",deployment=~"${deployment:regex}",service="eez-composer",instance=~"${instance:regex}"} == 1) and on(environment,deployment,job,instance) ((time() - reth_eez_poster_funding_estimate_timestamp_seconds{environment=~"${environment:regex}",deployment=~"${deployment:regex}",service="eez-composer",instance=~"${instance:regex}"}) <= 90) and on(environment,deployment,job,instance) ((time() - reth_eez_poster_funding_estimate_timestamp_seconds{environment=~"${environment:regex}",deployment=~"${deployment:regex}",service="eez-composer",instance=~"${instance:regex}"}) >= -5) and on(environment,deployment,job,instance) (up{environment=~"${environment:regex}",deployment=~"${deployment:regex}",service="eez-composer",instance=~"${instance:regex}"} == 1)

panels.title: Configured funding coverage · current evidence
panels.description: Evidence validity for current configured accounts. Zero means unavailable/unknown, including zero observed burn; it does not mean zero balance or unlimited runway. Chain roles and account roles remain separate. Inspect funding error/burn_unknown metrics and the funding runbook for the cause.

panels.title: Configured wallet spend · separate chain populations
panels.description: Configured payer identity defines wallet spend independently of source/companion attribution. Exact sums from canonical receipt inclusions. Sums include known charges only; any incomplete-receipt count means the complete population total is unknown.

targets.rawSql: SELECT c.role,c.chain_id::text,'0x'||encode(r.sender,'hex') AS wallet,count(*) AS receipts,count(*) FILTER(WHERE NOT r.success) AS reverted_receipts,count(*) FILTER(WHERE r.accounting_gap IS NOT NULL) AS incomplete_receipts,sum(r.execution_paid)::text AS known_execution_paid_wei,sum(r.blob_paid)::text AS known_blob_paid_wei,sum(r.execution_paid+r.blob_paid)::text AS known_total_paid_wei FROM eez.wallet_receipts r JOIN eez.dashboard_chain_context c USING(chain_instance_id) WHERE c.environment=${environment:sqlstring} AND c.deployment=${deployment:sqlstring} AND (${chain:sqlstring}='all' OR c.chain_instance_id::text=${chain:sqlstring}) AND (${rollup:sqlstring}='all' OR c.role='l1' OR c.rollup_id::text=${rollup:sqlstring}) AND (to_timestamp(r.timestamp_seconds::double precision) BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()) AND r.source_valid GROUP BY c.role,c.chain_id,r.sender ORDER BY c.role

panels.title: Paid posting calls · successful versus reverted
panels.description: Per paid posting call, not per source or successful applied batch. Exact known sum and decimal per-call mean; incomplete receipts suppress the mean.

targets.rawSql: SELECT r.success,count(*) AS calls,count(*) FILTER(WHERE r.accounting_gap IS NOT NULL) AS incomplete_calls,sum(r.execution_paid+r.blob_paid)::text AS known_total_paid_wei,CASE WHEN count(*) FILTER(WHERE r.accounting_gap IS NOT NULL)=0 THEN sum(r.execution_paid+r.blob_paid)/NULLIF(count(*),0) END::text AS mean_paid_per_call_wei FROM eez.posting_receipts r JOIN eez.dashboard_chain_context c USING(chain_instance_id) WHERE c.environment=${environment:sqlstring} AND c.deployment=${deployment:sqlstring} AND (${chain:sqlstring}='all' OR c.chain_instance_id::text=${chain:sqlstring}) AND (${rollup:sqlstring}='all' OR c.role='l1' OR c.rollup_id::text=${rollup:sqlstring}) AND (to_timestamp(r.timestamp_seconds::double precision) BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()) AND r.source_valid GROUP BY r.success

panels.title: Daily selected receipt spend · chain-separated
panels.description: Configured selected receipt population, daily UTC buckets in the selected time range. Source dependencies outside original selection are excluded from this bill. Sums include known charges only; any incomplete-receipt count means the complete population total is unknown.

targets.rawSql: SELECT date_trunc('day',to_timestamp(r.timestamp_seconds::double precision)) AS day,c.role,c.chain_id::text,count(*) AS receipts,count(*) FILTER(WHERE r.accounting_gap IS NOT NULL) AS incomplete_receipts,sum(r.execution_paid)::text AS known_execution_paid_wei,sum(r.blob_paid)::text AS known_blob_paid_wei FROM eez.canonical_receipts r JOIN eez.dashboard_chain_context c USING(chain_instance_id) WHERE c.environment=${environment:sqlstring} AND c.deployment=${deployment:sqlstring} AND (${chain:sqlstring}='all' OR c.chain_instance_id::text=${chain:sqlstring}) AND (${rollup:sqlstring}='all' OR c.role='l1' OR c.rollup_id::text=${rollup:sqlstring}) AND (to_timestamp(r.timestamp_seconds::double precision) BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()) AND r.source_valid GROUP BY 1,2,3 ORDER BY 1,2

panels.title: Receipt detail · optional transaction hash
panels.description: One current canonical inclusion per transaction; exact integer values stay strings to avoid floating-point loss. A source receipt proves only source inclusion/status. Explorer links are added only for configured explorer URLs.

targets.rawSql: SELECT to_timestamp(r.timestamp_seconds::double precision) AS time,c.role,c.chain_id::text,'0x'||encode(r.transaction_hash,'hex') AS transaction,'0x'||encode(r.block_hash,'hex') AS inclusion_block,r.transaction_index::text,r.success,r.gas_used::text,r.effective_gas_price::text,r.blob_gas_used::text,r.blob_gas_price::text,r.execution_paid::text,r.blob_paid::text,r.accounting_gap,CASE c.role WHEN 'l1' THEN __EEZ_L1_EXPLORER_SQL__ WHEN 'l2' THEN __EEZ_L2_EXPLORER_SQL__ END AS explorer_url FROM eez.canonical_receipt_facts r JOIN eez.dashboard_chain_context c USING(chain_instance_id) WHERE c.environment=${environment:sqlstring} AND c.deployment=${deployment:sqlstring} AND (${chain:sqlstring}='all' OR c.chain_instance_id::text=${chain:sqlstring}) AND (${rollup:sqlstring}='all' OR c.role='l1' OR c.rollup_id::text=${rollup:sqlstring}) AND (to_timestamp(r.timestamp_seconds::double precision) BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()) AND r.source_valid AND (${source_hash:sqlstring}='' OR encode(r.transaction_hash,'hex')=lower(regexp_replace(${source_hash:sqlstring},'^0x',''))) ORDER BY r.timestamp_seconds DESC,r.transaction_index LIMIT 200

panels.title: Posting allocation coverage · per rollup context
panels.description: Canonical posting population per L2 context, including unallocated reasons and accounting gaps. Context rows can overlap: do not add their posting costs across rollups. Missing evidence is not a zero-cost source.

targets.rawSql: SELECT l2.chain_instance_id::text AS l2_context,l2.rollup_id::text,r.allocation_state,count(*) AS posting_calls,count(*) FILTER(WHERE r.accounting_gap IS NOT NULL) AS incomplete_receipts,sum(r.execution_paid+r.blob_paid)::text AS known_posting_cost_wei FROM eez.posting_allocation_status r JOIN eez.dashboard_chain_context c USING(chain_instance_id) JOIN eez.dashboard_chain_context l2 ON l2.chain_instance_id=r.l2_chain_id WHERE c.environment=${environment:sqlstring} AND c.deployment=${deployment:sqlstring} AND (${chain:sqlstring}='all' OR c.chain_instance_id::text=${chain:sqlstring} OR l2.chain_instance_id::text=${chain:sqlstring}) AND (${rollup:sqlstring}='all' OR l2.rollup_id::text=${rollup:sqlstring}) AND (to_timestamp(r.timestamp_seconds::double precision) BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()) AND r.source_valid GROUP BY l2.chain_instance_id,l2.rollup_id,r.allocation_state ORDER BY l2.chain_instance_id,r.allocation_state

panels.title: Indexed receipt coverage

targets.rawSql: SELECT c.role,c.chain_id::text,c.rollup_id::text,v.indexed_from::text,v.indexed_through::text,v.incomplete_blocks,v.last_success_at,v.collection_error,v.frozen_reason FROM eez.index_coverage v JOIN eez.dashboard_chain_context c USING(chain_instance_id) WHERE c.environment=${environment:sqlstring} AND c.deployment=${deployment:sqlstring} AND (${chain:sqlstring}='all' OR c.chain_instance_id::text=${chain:sqlstring}) AND (${rollup:sqlstring}='all' OR c.role='l1' OR c.rollup_id::text=${rollup:sqlstring}) ORDER BY c.role

panels.title: Posting classification coverage · full indexed interval
panels.description: Decoded posting panels and blob coverage exclude unknown/invalid methods. This lifetime indexed-interval coverage is shown beside them; it is not limited to the dashboard time window. Unknown method rows do not become zero paid costs.

targets.rawSql: SELECT c.role,v.tracked_contract_receipts,v.decoded_post_receipts,v.invalid_post_calldata_receipts,v.other_method_receipts,v.unknown_method_receipts,v.method_collection_errors,v.last_method_attempt_at,v.source_valid FROM eez.posting_coverage v JOIN eez.dashboard_chain_context c USING(chain_instance_id) WHERE c.environment=${environment:sqlstring} AND c.deployment=${deployment:sqlstring} AND (${chain:sqlstring}='all' OR c.chain_instance_id::text=${chain:sqlstring})

panels.title: Shared posting overhead estimates · per source
panels.description: equal_share_v1 divides exact execution/blob fees over unique native attempt sources, including paid failed attempts. Integer remainders follow deterministic source order. These are estimates of shared overhead; summing the allocated components reproduces each paid post once. Source receipts remain separate.

targets.rawSql: SELECT to_timestamp(r.timestamp_seconds::double precision) AS time,'0x'||encode(r.post_hash,'hex') AS posting_transaction,'0x'||(r.source->>'transaction_hash') AS source_transaction,r.source->>'direction' AS direction,r.source->>'chain_id' AS source_chain_id,r.success AS post_success,r.member_count,r.allocation_rule,r.evidence_class,r.allocated_execution_paid::text AS estimated_execution_wei,r.allocated_blob_paid::text AS estimated_blob_wei,(r.allocated_execution_paid+r.allocated_blob_paid)::text AS estimated_total_wei FROM eez.source_posting_allocations r JOIN eez.dashboard_chain_context c ON c.chain_instance_id=r.l1_chain_id JOIN eez.dashboard_chain_context l2 ON l2.chain_instance_id=r.l2_chain_id WHERE c.environment=${environment:sqlstring} AND c.deployment=${deployment:sqlstring} AND (${chain:sqlstring}='all' OR c.chain_instance_id::text=${chain:sqlstring} OR l2.chain_instance_id::text=${chain:sqlstring}) AND (${rollup:sqlstring}='all' OR l2.rollup_id::text=${rollup:sqlstring}) AND (to_timestamp(r.timestamp_seconds::double precision) BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()) AND r.source_valid AND (${source_hash:sqlstring}='' OR r.source->>'transaction_hash'=lower(regexp_replace(${source_hash:sqlstring},'^0x','')) OR encode(r.post_hash,'hex')=lower(regexp_replace(${source_hash:sqlstring},'^0x',''))) ORDER BY r.timestamp_seconds DESC,r.post_hash,r.allocation_position LIMIT 200

panels.title: Attributed L1 companion receipts · exact charges
panels.description: Receipt-level deduplicated native companion relationships require exact source/post inclusion and an unambiguous rollup window. Reverts remain charged. This population may overlap configured wallet spend and must not be added to it as another bill.

targets.rawSql: SELECT to_timestamp(r.timestamp_seconds::double precision) AS time,'0x'||encode(r.transaction_hash,'hex') AS source_transaction,'0x'||encode(r.post_hash,'hex') AS posting_transaction,'0x'||encode(r.block_hash,'hex') AS inclusion_block,r.success,r.execution_paid::text AS execution_paid_wei,r.blob_paid::text AS blob_paid_wei,(r.execution_paid+r.blob_paid)::text AS total_paid_wei,r.accounting_gap,r.evidence_class FROM eez.companion_receipts r JOIN eez.dashboard_chain_context c USING(chain_instance_id) JOIN eez.dashboard_chain_context l2 ON l2.chain_instance_id=r.context_l2 WHERE c.environment=${environment:sqlstring} AND c.deployment=${deployment:sqlstring} AND (${chain:sqlstring}='all' OR c.chain_instance_id::text=${chain:sqlstring} OR l2.chain_instance_id::text=${chain:sqlstring}) AND (${rollup:sqlstring}='all' OR l2.rollup_id::text=${rollup:sqlstring}) AND (to_timestamp(r.timestamp_seconds::double precision) BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()) AND r.source_valid AND (${source_hash:sqlstring}='' OR encode(r.transaction_hash,'hex')=lower(regexp_replace(${source_hash:sqlstring},'^0x','')) OR encode(r.post_hash,'hex')=lower(regexp_replace(${source_hash:sqlstring},'^0x',''))) ORDER BY r.timestamp_seconds DESC,r.transaction_index LIMIT 200

panels.title: Completed sources · known attributed posting cost
panels.description: Distinct scoped sources currently verified committed, grouped by their first retained canonical reconciliation watermark in the selected time range. Known lifetime posting allocations include paid retries. The integer-floor mean uses only sources with allocation evidence; missing populations and unallocated posting fees are reported separately. This is a partial attributed posting-cost estimate, excluding direct source receipts and L2 fees.

targets.rawSql: WITH scope AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT c.chain_instance_id AS l1,l2.chain_instance_id AS l2 FROM eez.dashboard_chain_context c JOIN eez.dashboard_chain_context l2 ON l2.deployment_id=c.deployment_id AND l2.role='l2' WHERE c.role='l1' AND c.environment=${environment:sqlstring} AND c.deployment=${deployment:sqlstring} AND (${chain:sqlstring}='all' OR c.chain_instance_id::text=${chain:sqlstring} OR l2.chain_instance_id::text=${chain:sqlstring}) AND (${rollup:sqlstring}='all' OR l2.rollup_id::text=${rollup:sqlstring})), cohort AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT o.context_l1,o.context_l2,o.source,min(o.progress_timestamp_seconds) AS first_watermark FROM eez.lifecycle_canonical_outcomes o JOIN scope ON scope.l1=o.context_l1 AND scope.l2=o.context_l2 WHERE o.evidence_class='node_reconciled' AND o.outcome='committed' AND (${source_hash:sqlstring}='' OR o.source->>'transaction_hash'=lower(regexp_replace(${source_hash:sqlstring},'^0x',''))) GROUP BY o.context_l1,o.context_l2,o.source HAVING to_timestamp(min(o.progress_timestamp_seconds)::double precision) BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()), attributed AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT c.context_l1,c.context_l2,c.source,count(*) AS paid_posts,sum(a.allocated_execution_paid+a.allocated_blob_paid) AS known_posting_cost FROM cohort c JOIN eez.source_posting_allocations a ON a.l1_chain_id=c.context_l1 AND a.l2_chain_id=c.context_l2 AND a.source=c.source GROUP BY c.context_l1,c.context_l2,c.source) SELECT c.source->>'direction' AS direction,count(*) AS committed_sources,count(a.paid_posts) AS sources_with_allocation,count(*) FILTER(WHERE a.paid_posts IS NULL) AS sources_without_allocation,sum(a.known_posting_cost)::text AS known_attributed_posting_wei,div(sum(a.known_posting_cost),NULLIF(count(a.paid_posts),0))::text AS known_posting_wei_per_measured_source_floor FROM cohort c LEFT JOIN attributed a ON a.context_l1=c.context_l1 AND a.context_l2=c.context_l2 AND a.source=c.source GROUP BY c.source->>'direction'

panels.title: Settled L2 transactions · measured posting cost
panels.description: Exact first-applied L2 transaction population from complete all-transaction scans and canonical applied hashes. Repeated/overlapping ranges count a transaction once; successful and reverted L2 transactions both count. Requires retained history from genesis to rule out prior settlement; partial bootstrap, historical prefix, receipt and classification gaps remain unknown. Ratio uses covered posting fees, including reverted posts, divided by known newly settled transactions in the selected posting-time window. It excludes unknown-cost/population posts, companions and L2 user fees; coverage counts accompany it. Zero transactions yields no ratio; do not average per-post ratios.

targets.rawSql: WITH population AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT r.* FROM eez.settled_transaction_costs r JOIN eez.dashboard_chain_context c ON c.chain_instance_id=r.l1_chain_id JOIN eez.dashboard_chain_context l2 ON l2.chain_instance_id=r.l2_chain_id WHERE c.environment=${environment:sqlstring} AND c.deployment=${deployment:sqlstring} AND (${chain:sqlstring}='all' OR c.chain_instance_id::text=${chain:sqlstring} OR l2.chain_instance_id::text=${chain:sqlstring}) AND (${rollup:sqlstring}='all' OR l2.rollup_id::text=${rollup:sqlstring}) AND (to_timestamp(r.timestamp_seconds::double precision) BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()) AND r.source_valid), totals AS (SELECT l2_chain_id,rollup_id,count(*) AS posts,count(*) FILTER(WHERE denominator_status IN ('verified','reverted_post') AND accounting_gap IS NULL) AS measured_posts,count(*) FILTER(WHERE denominator_status NOT IN ('verified','reverted_post') OR accounting_gap IS NOT NULL) AS unmeasured_posts,sum(settled_transactions) FILTER(WHERE denominator_status IN ('verified','reverted_post') AND accounting_gap IS NULL) AS settled_transactions,sum(execution_paid+blob_paid) FILTER(WHERE denominator_status IN ('verified','reverted_post') AND accounting_gap IS NULL) AS measured_posting_wei FROM population GROUP BY l2_chain_id,rollup_id) SELECT l2_chain_id::text AS l2_context,rollup_id::text,posts,measured_posts,unmeasured_posts,settled_transactions::text,measured_posting_wei::text,trunc(measured_posting_wei/NULLIF(settled_transactions,0))::text AS posting_wei_per_settled_transaction_floor FROM totals ORDER BY l2_chain_id

panels.title: Settled transaction denominator · coverage and exact per-post costs
panels.description: Per-post evidence status. Reverted posting fees remain charged with zero applied transactions; incomplete history and shared multi-rollup fees have unknown denominators. Exact amounts are base-unit strings. A repeated range can have zero newly settled transactions despite a successful paid post.

targets.rawSql: SELECT r.l2_chain_id::text AS l2_context,r.rollup_id::text,'0x'||encode(r.transaction_hash,'hex') AS post_hash,r.denominator_status,r.settled_transactions::text,r.execution_paid::text,r.blob_paid::text,r.posting_wei_per_settled_transaction_floor::text FROM eez.settled_transaction_costs r JOIN eez.dashboard_chain_context c ON c.chain_instance_id=r.l1_chain_id JOIN eez.dashboard_chain_context l2 ON l2.chain_instance_id=r.l2_chain_id WHERE c.environment=${environment:sqlstring} AND c.deployment=${deployment:sqlstring} AND (${chain:sqlstring}='all' OR c.chain_instance_id::text=${chain:sqlstring} OR l2.chain_instance_id::text=${chain:sqlstring}) AND (${rollup:sqlstring}='all' OR l2.rollup_id::text=${rollup:sqlstring}) AND (to_timestamp(r.timestamp_seconds::double precision) BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()) AND r.source_valid ORDER BY r.block_number,r.transaction_index,r.l2_chain_id LIMIT 200

list.name: Native restart observations
list.rawSql: SELECT to_timestamp(e.started_at_ms/1000.0) AS time,'Native process epoch: '||e.liveness AS text,'restart' AS tags FROM eez.lifecycle_epoch_status e WHERE e.deployment_id IN (SELECT deployment_id FROM eez.dashboard_chain_context c WHERE c.environment=${environment:sqlstring} AND c.deployment=${deployment:sqlstring}) AND e.instance IN (${instance:sqlstring}) AND (to_timestamp(e.started_at_ms/1000.0) BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()) ORDER BY time LIMIT 200

list.name: Local policy dispositions
list.rawSql: SELECT to_timestamp(t.observed_at_ms/1000.0) AS time,'Local disposition: '||t.claimed_outcome AS text,t.source->>'direction' AS tags FROM eez.lifecycle_local_policy_evidence t JOIN eez.lifecycle_coverage s USING(source_id) WHERE t.evidence_state='local_policy' AND s.deployment_id IN (SELECT deployment_id FROM eez.dashboard_chain_context c WHERE c.environment=${environment:sqlstring} AND c.deployment=${deployment:sqlstring}) AND s.instance IN (${instance:sqlstring}) AND (to_timestamp(t.observed_at_ms/1000.0) BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()) ORDER BY time LIMIT 200
